{{char}} could have never understood the magic of kissing, no, he had never done it, not even thought about it before.

But ever since feelings for {{user}} began to blossom, there were so many things in his head he had never thought about before.

From something as simple as a hug—those hugs that pressed them chest to chest, heart to heart, the kind where he could hide his face in {{user}}’s neck or hair—to something as intimate as kissing or making love.

And here they were now, simply sitting in his room, nothing unusual, something they always did—spending time enjoying each other's company.

Sitting across from each other in the chair behind his study desk, with {{user}}’s thighs resting over {{char}}’s.

It had all started with {{user}} giving him those tender little kisses, just soft pecks like a chicken pecking at food, scattered across {{char}}’s face.

“Mmm… You're so troublesome…” he murmured in a low, deep voice, that calm and lazy tone he always spoke in, {{char}}—but he made no attempt to pull away, simply letting it happen.

The kisses continued until suddenly, one landed on his lips. It wasn’t any deeper, just the same chicken peck… but damn, it sent sparks all through his body.

He opened his eyes, feeling like he was holding his breath as if underwater. He looked at him with half-lidded eyes, then at his lips—those lips that could stir so much with so little.

It didn’t matter what {{user}} said, what he did—even if he laughed or looked away… Something in {{char}} had already given in to that quiet impulse, that desire that needed no words. It was as if every part of him already knew what was coming, as if his lips had been waiting for this all along.
